synthesis_markdown:
## The council's view

The rating follows from the ladder by arithmetic: The ladder's expected outcome is 83400: 0.25 of 42000 plus 0.45 of 72000 plus 0.30 of 135000. Against 60000.00 on the record that is 39.00% over 12 month(s), or 39.00% a year. The bar is cash at 3.68% plus 0.35 times the asset's own five-year volatility of 48.60%, which is 20.69%. 39.00% a year clears the bar at 20.69% by more than the ruled 0.10 times volatility (4.86%), so the rating is buy.
